description.en: Runtime evidence discipline for DeepSeek Harness that does not rely on the model agreeing with itself. A bounded anti-hallucination contract is injected as one short system-prompt section, and four checks run outside the model: a ledger written only by real tool dispatches, so an entry cannot be fabricated; a provenance gate that records (and in the strict profile refuses) a call whose path, URL, id, account, or amount has no origin in the session; a risk gate that holds destructive, outward-facing, or paid tools, plus shell commands that delete, publish, or send, for confirmation; and an injection shield that marks web, file, MCP, and A2A output as data rather than instructions, counting instruction-like fragments it finds. Before sending an answer the model calls answer_verify with one claim per assertion, each citing a ledger id and the exact quoted excerpt; the verifier compares quotes against the stored result, so a fabricated number fails even when a tool call did happen. Time-sensitive claims (price, incumbent, version, current) must cite evidence inside an age limit. Every verdict reports the verification level it applied (light, standard, strict) and the output form the answer should take (direct, annotate, or abstain with what is missing), plus running metrics such as verification counts, pass rate and quote rate, and the Settings panel shows those same counts in plain language. Three profiles cover the tradeoff: observe only records, inspect also blocks and annotates, adjudicate additionally refuses untraceable targets, and the Settings panel labels the three of them 静观 (observe), 明察 (inspect) and 断案 (adjudicate). Ships a plain-language Settings panel with a collapsible technical section, durable profile selection, and a read-only ledger_view tool. No embedding service, no vector database, no network calls, no runtime dependencies.

description.zh: 让指挥者只负责拆活派活和验收，执行全交给小组长，适合只想做决策的场景。

description.en: Dreaming for DeepSeek Harness: consolidates past sessions into reviewed, versioned memory
description.zh: 每天空闲时自动整理各工作区的新会话，把零散对话沉淀成可审阅、带版本记忆。

description.en: 阻止 agent 自行执行 git commit、git push 等写操作，装到 profile 后对整个 Harness 生效。
description.zh: 拦住 agent 自己执行 git commit、git push 这类写操作，装到 profile 后对整个 Harness 生效。

description.en: 工作日打卡 + 每日学习记录 + 周报。DeepSeek Harness 插件，可选接入 dsh-pet 桌宠。
description.zh: 每天记录到工位时间、学习内容和心情，周末自动汇总成周报，还能连桌宠陪你打卡。

description.en: 归置（Stow）：按你的工作流归置 DSH 插件、工具与技能，生成可导出能力包。A DeepSeek Harness plugin for inventorying installed plugins/tools/skills by workflow and building exportable capability packs.
description.zh: 帮你理清装了什么插件、工具和技能，按工作流归置成可导出的能力包。

description.en: 把一张插画变成可打样的 PCB 艺术板 —— 嘉立创打样券驱动的 DSH 插件（异形板框 / 分色造型 / 工艺校验 / 下单参数）
description.zh: 把插画一键变成嘉立创可打样的 PCB 艺术板，自动出异形板框、分色造型和下单参数。

description.en: Root-session Leader contract for DeepSeek Harness: orchestrate, delegate to subagents, audit.
description.zh: 给主会话注入 Leader 契约，让主智能体负责规划、拆分任务、派发子智能体并审计结果。

description.en: Three DeepSeek Harness packages for OpenFOAM mesh work: STL generation with in-process JS QA (33+ knowledge cards), snappyHexMesh/cfMesh/gmsh routes with a checkMesh quality gate, and one-command delivery as an OpenFOAM case plus an ANSYS/Fluent .msh. Works in an empty directory — no project profile required.
description.zh: OpenFOAM 网格一站式工具包，从 STL 生成到 snappyHexMesh/cfMesh/gmsh 划分，自带 checkMesh 质量门禁。

description.en: DSH panel to simulate Claude Code / Codex client fingerprints for one selected provider, with atomic header+body transformation.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加个侧栏面板，选一个供应商模拟 Claude Code 或 Codex 客户端指纹，保存即生效。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：定时抓取 RSS，按类别生成可回看的新闻日报
description.zh: 每天定时抓取 RSS 新闻，按类别汇总成能回看的日报，错过还会自动补一份。

description.en: Pirate mode bundle for DeepSeek Harness: pirate brand marks, eight-language packs, rotating status phrases, ocean background and an editable first-mate persona.
增强dsh文件管理功能
description.zh: 把剪切、复制、粘贴、压缩解压和 SQLite 可视化管理直接塞进文件树右键菜单，不新增页面。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的单工程侧边栏插件：顶部是工程切换器，下面只列当前工程的会话。Single-project sidebar for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 把侧边栏改成一次只看一个工程，顶部切换工程，下面只列当前工程的会话，找起来更清爽。

description.en: A DSH plugin: puppies on a pixel-art island act out every real step your AI agent takes. 给新手看 AI 在电脑上干什么。
description.zh: 把 AI 在电脑上的每一步操作变成像素小岛上小狗的表演，新手也能一眼看懂 AI 在干嘛。

description.en: 逆向分析 · DSH 插件：把 REA 的 207 个逆向工具延迟加载进 Agent 工具表，自带运行时解包、环境侧栏与 Ghidra/JADX/Apktool 一键准备
description.zh: 把 REA 的 207 个逆向工具按需加载进 Agent，还能一键备好 Ghidra、JADX、Apktool 环境，逆向分析更省事。

description.en: DSH 研报知识库插件：DeepSeek 驱动的可溯源 Obsidian 研究工作台
description.zh: 把 PDF 或 Markdown 研报整理成中文可溯源的 Obsidian 知识库，数据出处一目了然。

description.en: 侧栏 DSH 标志旁的两个图标负责重启 DSH 和退出 DSH，对话右上方的按钮用来刷新页面和热更新插件代码。 | Two icons beside the sidebar DSH logo restart or quit the desktop app; the button at the top right of the conversation refreshes the page and hot-reloads plugin code.
description.zh: 不用退出应用就能重启、关闭 DSH，还能一键刷新页面并热更新插件代码。

description.en: Export any DSH session as a portable Markdown or JSON transcript that can move to another machine or resume in another agent.
description.zh: 把任意 DSH 会话导出成 Markdown 或 JSON 记录，方便换机器接着用或在别的智能体里恢复。

description.en: Session-scoped glossary with notes and read-only AI context for DeepSeek Harness.
Local store for third-party skills and MCP servers: npm/GitHub/SkillHub/zip install, dependency self-heal, other-agent import, Web panel and CLI.
description.zh: 本地统一管理第三方技能和 MCP 服务器，支持多种方式安装、依赖自愈、导入其他智能体配置，并提供网页面板和命令行操作。

description.en: 给 DeepSeek Harness 写 skill 与插件的手册：六个 skill 根目录、frontmatter 校验、12 个静默失败的坑
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 写 skill 和插件的手册，帮你避开那些不报错、只静默失败的坑。

description.en: DSH todo 纪律守卫：模型多步任务里偏离 todo 列表时，在工具结果后提醒建表 / 更新 / 收尾
description.zh: 多步任务里模型跑偏忘了 todo 列表时，在工具结果后及时提醒它建表、更新和收尾。

description.en: Bounded-replay compaction engine for DeepSeek Harness: caps every summarization pass, adds model-driven compaction tools and a context-pressure reminder.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的上下文压缩加上次数上限，并提供模型驱动的压缩工具和上下文压力提醒，防止摘要失控。

description.en: DSH 花费：侧栏 DeepSeek 余额与官方峰谷状态，加设置页的 token 用量账本（热力图、构成、趋势、当天明细，已删除会话仍计入）。
description.zh: 侧栏常驻 DeepSeek 余额和峰谷状态，设置页用热力图、趋势和明细把每笔 token 花费算清楚。

description.en: Stop-all for DeepSeek Harness: one click stops the whole conversation tree (main turn + subagents at any depth + their background jobs) with native stop semantics.
description.zh: 一键停掉整棵对话树，主回合、各层子代理和它们的后台任务全部干净收手。

description.en: Remote access for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI over tailcat: one-click tailcat installation, a pairing page, a tailnet-only door, and a supervised tailcat server — no public port and no inbound firewall change.
description.zh: 用 tailcat 把 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面安全地开放到任何网络，不用开公网端口，也不用改防火墙。

description.en: Fix Tencent buddy/workbuddy channels in DSH: moves the harness system prompt into the first user message so the vendor channel check (HTTP 400 code 11128) stops rejecting requests.
description.zh: 修复 DSH 里腾讯 buddy/workbuddy 频道被拦截报 400 的问题，把系统提示词挪进首条用户消息，请求就能正常通过。

description.en: Delete any turn from a DeepSeek Harness session's model context — multi-select, log untouched, instantly effective.
description.zh: 把会话里不想要的那轮对话从模型上下文中删掉，日志和会话都保留，省 token 又不跑偏。

description.en: 通过 WebDAV 在多设备间同步 DeepSeek Harness 的配置与插件（含服务商预设、自动上传、确定性快照校验与下载前备份），不同步会话。
description.zh: 用 WebDAV 把 DSH 的配置和插件在多台设备间同步，会话数据不跟着走。

description.en: Brings Zotero's whole reading workflow into DSH: library, PDFs and annotations all live here, with no switching between apps. Library: browse every item by Zotero collection tree, searchable, plus a This session view listing only the papers the current conversation matched. Reading: outline navigation, in-document find with case and whole-word options, per-paper memory of reading position and zoom, and several PDFs open at once without interfering. Annotations: highlights made in Zotero show up here, and comments, tags, recoloring and deletion written here go back to Zotero. Page-cited answers: replies are grounded in the paper text, each claim carries a real page number, and clicking it jumps to that page and highlights it. Selection actions: translate, explain, ask or highlight from any selection. Models and credentials: translation, explanation and asking can each use their own provider and model picked from what you have configured, falling back to the current conversation when left empty; Zotero cloud, MinerU and embedding credentials are entered separately and never held in plain text on the page, with a one-click connectivity test. Scanned or broken-text PDFs: re-parse on demand, off by default.
description.zh: 把 Zotero 的整套阅读工作搬进了 DSH：文献库、PDF、批注都在这里，不必再在两个应用之间来回切。文献库：按 Zotero 专题树浏览全部文献，可搜索；「本次搜索」只列出这轮对话里 AI 命中的那几篇。阅读：大纲按章节跳转，文档内查找支持区分大小写、整词与高亮所有，每篇论文记住阅读位置和缩放，多篇 PDF 可同时开着互不干扰。批注：Zotero 里做的批注在这里能看到，这里加的评论、标签、改色与删除也会写回 Zotero。带页码问答：基于论文原文回答，每个结论标出真实页码，点页码跳回原文并高亮。划词动作：选中一段即可翻译、解释、追问或标成高亮。模型与凭据：划词翻译、解释、提问可分别指定服务商与模型，从已配置的列表里选，留空则跟随当前会话；Zotero 云端、MinerU 与 Embedding 的凭据单独填写，页面不保存明文，可一键测试连通性。扫描件与图纸：文本层损坏或扫描版可按需重新解析，默认关闭。

description.en: LitGraph: literature knowledge-graph plugin for DeepSeek Harness (star-map graph, PDF/Zotero import, OCR, notes, ratings, journal metrics)
description.zh: 把文献整理成星图式知识图谱，支持 PDF/Zotero 导入、OCR 识别、笔记评分和期刊指标，方便梳理研究脉络。

description.en: 永久免费的广告管理和优化插件。支持 GPT Ads、Google Ads、Meta Ads、Microsoft Ads、Amazon Ads 和 TikTok Ads，提供投放报表和 API 权限控制。官网 https://ads-mcp.octer.ai  Free-forever ad management and optimization for DeepSeek Harness. OCTER Ads supports GPT Ads, Google Ads, Meta Ads, Microsoft Ads, Amazon Ads, and TikTok Ads. Includes performance reports and API access controls.
description.zh: 永久免费管理并优化 GPT、Google、Meta、TikTok 等六大平台广告，还能看投放报表、控制 API 权限。

description.en: Opencodego package usage monitoring plugin for DSH
description.zh: 在界面浮层里实时查看 opencode Go 套餐的滚动、每周和每月用量，用量一目了然。

description.en: Covers the conversation area with a character-cell vertical shooter; closing it leaves the chat untouched.
description.zh: 在对话区上覆盖一层字符飞机大战；关闭战场层后对话原样保留。

description.en: Actively maintained fork of dsh-memory-evolve (upstream last pushed 2026-10-29): cross-session long-term memory plus background self-evolution for DeepSeek Harness — five-track memory (memory, user, key, project, daily), git-branch awareness, in-turn self-review, skill self-evolution and skill manager, four-track to-dos, COI scheduling, session broadcast, session search, prompt manager and scratch notes. Pure plugin, zero core modifications, zero runtime dependencies. On top of upstream 44b6b3e it adds Windows fixes (git child-process tree cleanup, canvas private-key path blocking, hidden consoles), a repeatable test suite with CI on Windows and Linux, and 15 merged upstream community pull requests with their authors credited. Its HTTP routes are checked by the DSH access layer (connection.requestRejection) since v0.7.1 and, on top of that, guarded by the plugin itself since v0.5.0: same-origin check, JSON-only writes, DNS-rebinding guard, loopback-only default.
description.zh: 活跃维护中的 dsh-memory-evolve 分支（上游最后提交于 2026-10-29）：为 DeepSeek Harness 带来「跨会话长期记忆 + 后台自我进化」——五轨记忆（memory / user / key / project / daily）· git 分支感知 · 回合内自我审查 · 技能自我进化与技能管理器 · 四轨待办 · COI 调度 · 会话广播 · 会话搜索 · 提示词管理器 · 临时信息便签。纯插件实现、零核心修改、零运行时依赖。在上游基础上补齐 Windows 修复（git 子进程树清理、画板私钥路径拦截、隐藏控制台）、可重复测试与 Windows/Linux 双平台 CI，并合并了 15 个上游社区 PR（提交里保留原作者署名）。自 v0.7.1 起它的 HTTP 路由会先经 DSH 准入层（connection.requestRejection）检查，并在此基础上叠加插件自带的同源守卫（v0.5.0 起）：同源校验、仅接受 JSON、DNS rebinding 防护、默认只允许本机回环。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的邮件通知插件
description.zh: 任务或对话跑完时自动发邮件提醒你，不用守着屏幕等结果。

description.en: Run trusted Python scripts in the workspace, read text from searchable PDFs, and export DOCX to PDF through Microsoft Word on Windows.
description.zh: 在工作区运行受信任的 Python 脚本、读取可搜索 PDF 的文本，并在 Windows 上通过 Microsoft Word 把 DOCX 导出为 PDF。

description.en: Full-window background image for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, with adjustable scrim, panel opacity, and blur in Settings > General.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 铺满整窗的背景图片，可在“设置 > 通用”中调整遮罩、面板浓度与模糊。

description.en: Unofficial DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugins: in-place conversation rewind with file restore, and real session deletion with trash + audit log.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加一套靠谱的插件，能真正删除会话并放进回收站，还能记录审计日志。

description.en: Side chat for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: fork the current session into an ephemeral conversation that can really edit files, without polluting the main transcript.
description.zh: 从当前会话分出一个临时侧边会话，能真正改文件，又不弄脏主对话记录。

description.en: Batch approvals with a risk gate and an auditable decision ledger for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 给批量审批加一道风险闸门，每次决定都记进可审计的账本，方便事后追溯。

description.en: Cross-session messaging plugin for DeepSeek Harness: let user-launched sessions in one workspace message each other and coordinate tasks, write scopes, and conflicts.
MT 管理器 MCP 连接 DeepSeek Harness 插件：在 Web 设置页填 MT 的 MCP 地址，手机文件/APK/ZIP 能力以 mcp__mt__* 工具可用。Connect MT Manager (Android) to DeepSeek Harness as a DSH plugin.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里填上 MT 管理器的 MCP 地址，就能用 mcp__mt__* 工具直接操作手机上的文件、APK 和 ZIP。

description.en: Buckets every model call by local date, provider and model, then shows the totals in a sidebar card, a per-chat pill under the composer and a settings page, alongside each provider's account balance and subscription windows.
description.zh: 把每次模型调用按本地日期、供应商与模型记账，在侧栏卡片、输入框下方的单会话胶囊和设置页里展示用量合计，并同列展示各供应商的账户余额与套餐窗口。

description.en: One-click prompt rewriter in the DeepSeek Harness composer: three rewrite levels, follows the model you are already chatting with.

Overleaf-style LaTeX workbench in the DSH sidebar: syntax-highlighted editing with line numbers and sidecar comments, one-click compile with clean/auto modes and root-document discovery, live pdf.js preview with two-way SyncTeX jumps, plus multi-writer merge protection with automatic backups. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏里的 Overleaf 风格 LaTeX 工作台：语法高亮编辑、行号与行内评论，一键编译（清理/自动模式、主文档自动发现），pdf.js 实时预览与双向 SyncTeX 跳转，多写者自动合并与写前备份。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Searches campus-subscribed databases (IEEE Xplore, Springer Nature Link, ScienceDirect) through its own dedicated Chrome profile and downloads verified full-text PDFs. Merges results across databases by DOI, exports BibTeX/RIS, and leaves CARSI or IP-based institutional sign-in to the user so no credentials are stored or replayed.
description.zh: 用专用 Chrome 配置承接学校订阅授权（IEEE、Springer、ScienceDirect），检索并下载校验过的全文，跨库按 DOI 合并、导出 BibTeX/RIS；机构登录始终由人完成，不保存也不回放凭据。

description.en: Exposes the WorkBuddy models registered by dsh-connect-workbuddy over one local base URL in four protocols (OpenAI Chat Completions, OpenAI Responses, Anthropic Messages, Gemini), with per-API-key model checklists, region-suffixed names for models that repeat across the CN and Intl pools, and reasoning efforts passed through for the client to choose. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 把 dsh-connect-workbuddy 注册的 WorkBuddy 模型以四种协议（OpenAI Chat Completions、OpenAI Responses、Anthropic Messages、Gemini）开放成一个本机 base URL，按 API key 勾选要提供的模型，国内版与国际版重名时加区域后缀区分，推理档位交给客户端自己选。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Server fleet operations hub for DeepSeek Harness: keeps 6 SSH tools (list, exec, upload, download, tunnel, cluster) and adds 9 more for fleet inspection with retained rounds, metrics and alert rules, deployment rollout with per-batch health probes and rollback, cross-host log search, and an audit trail; agentless, all over SSH. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的服务器车队运维插件：保留 6 个 SSH 工具（清单、执行、上传、下载、隧道、集群），另加 9 个工具用于巡检并留存每轮结果、指标与告警规则、按批健康探测与失败回滚的部署发布、跨机日志检索，以及审计留痕；无 agent，全部通过 SSH 完成。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: A Tokyo Night theme plugin featuring three UI and syntax highlighting themes inspired by Enkia's Tokyo Night color scheme, along with a built-in, customizable glassmorphism skin that can be toggled on or off.
description.zh: Tokyo Night 主题插件， 包含以 Enkia 的 Tokyo Night 配色方案为参考的三个 UI 及代码着色主题,同时内置一套可开关和配置的玻璃质感皮肤。

description.en: Global wallpaper behind the whole DSH app (local file or URL, live-adjustable opacity) plus per-area custom fonts with Latin/CJK pickers, live previews and a searchable list of installed faces.
description.zh: 为 DSH 全局壁纸（本地图片或 URL，不透明度实时可调）+ 分区自定义字体：界面、对话、代码各配中西文字体，带预览与本机字体搜索。

description.en: A voice engine for DSH and any app that needs a voice: read aloud, dubbing with subtitles, audiobooks with a voice per character, your own cloned voice, real-time speech and transcription; pick free or paid sources (iFLYTEK, Edge, local Ming, Xiaomi MiMo, DeepSeek TTS, SiliconFlow or any OpenAI-compatible service) and share them with other plugins, dsh-her and AnyAudio.
description.zh: 声音引擎：给 DSH 和所有需要声音的软件提供声音——朗读、配音字幕、按角色配音的有声书、克隆自己的声音、实时发音、转写；讯飞、Edge、本机 Ming、小米 MiMo、DeepSeek 语音、硅基流动和任何 OpenAI 兼容的语音免费收费任选，也给别的插件、dsh-her、AnyAudio 用。

description.en: Unified capability hub for organizing MCP servers, tools, and skills into switchable suites with per-session injection.
description.zh: 统一能力中心，支持将 MCP 服务、细分工具与 Skills 编排为可切换的场景套件并按会话按需注入。

description.en: Kubernetes workbench for DeepSeek Harness: kubectl-backed multi-cluster tools, interactive OIDC login, CRD lists, container terminal, YAML editing, RBAC view, node cordon/uncordon/drain and cluster read/write mode. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Kubernetes 工作台：基于 kubectl 的多集群工具、交互式 OIDC 登录、CRD 列表、容器终端、YAML 编辑、RBAC 视图、节点封锁/解封/排空与集群读写模式。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Bridge ComfyUI into DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar panel lists the server workflows, models and run history, and 12 comfy_* tools let the chat model pick a workflow, send a prompt and override any parameter (steps, CFG, seed, resolution, checkpoint) before generating images, with server workflows loaded on demand instead of imported. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 把 ComfyUI 接进 DeepSeek Harness：侧边栏面板列出服务器上的工作流、模型与运行记录，12 个 comfy_* 工具让会话模型自己挑工作流、传提示词并覆盖任意参数（步数、CFG、随机种子、分辨率、模型）后出图；服务器工作流按需加载，无需导入。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: A sidebar mail client for DeepSeek Harness that sends and receives QQ, 163, Gmail and other IMAP/SMTP mailboxes, with new-mail notifications, an unread badge, read/unread filters, and authorization codes stored in the local credential vault.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏邮件客户端，收发 QQ、163、Gmail 等 IMAP/SMTP 邮箱，支持新邮件通知、未读角标、已读未读筛选，授权码保存在本机凭据保险箱。

description.en: Git-based backup and restore for DSH plugin manifests, configuration and skills, with per-item selection, previews, conflict preservation and credential filtering.
description.zh: 基于 Git 备份并还原 DSH 插件清单、配置和技能，支持逐项勾选、预览、冲突时保留本地版本和凭据过滤。

description.en: Project Steward: manage all your software projects like a department store. Categorized shelf board (downloads/views/comments/revenue), import listed products from npm/GitHub accounts, fully automated release pipeline with README/CHANGELOG gate, scheduled operations collection, competitor comparison radar + market-gap analysis, and per-version annotated update images. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 项目管家：像百货商店一样管理软件项目的发布/上架/运营。分区货架（下载/浏览/留言/收入）、从npm/GitHub账号导入已上架商品、全自动发布流水线（README/CHANGELOG门禁）、定时运营采集、竞品雷达对比+市场空白研判、逐版本更新位置标注图。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Reading desk for DSH: imports PDFs, cuts them into sections, tracks per-point mastery and schedules spaced review. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: DSH 知止读书台：导入 PDF 并按节切分，记录每个知识点的掌握度，安排间隔复习。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Centers the conversation transcript in the space beside the docked Session panel.
description.zh: 会话面板停靠后，将对话记录居中显示在旁边空间。

description.en: Gives the top-level sessions of a DSH instance a shared mailbox: eight tools that list the nearby sessions and workspaces, deliver a message addressed by title, short name or full id (a full id wakes a cold session), rename and create sessions, compact a session, archive sessions and unlist workspaces, and refuse delivery explicitly instead of reporting a fake success.
description.zh: 给 DSH 顶层会话之间加一个共用邮箱：八个工具，列出邻近的会话与工作区、按标题或短名或完整 id 投递消息（完整 id 可唤醒冷会话）、改名与新建会话、压缩指定会话、归档会话、删掉工作区注册；送不出去时明确拒绝，而不是假装送达。

description.en: Backs up the DSH setup into a Git repo — profile, global prompt, skills, agent presets, plugin settings and data, workspaces and sessions, 12 groups in all — and pushes it to your own Git remote or WebDAV. See at a glance how this machine differs from the remote, generate push / pull / restore scripts that run after the client exits, keep both sides when a pull collides with local edits, and restore config snapshots, plugin backups or sessions, including rolling back a broken plugin install. Runs on Windows (PowerShell), macOS and Linux (Node engine). Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 把整个 DSH 配置抓成一份 Git 仓库：profile、全局提示词、技能、Agent 预设、插件设置与数据、工作区与会话共 12 组，推送到自己的 Git 远端或 WebDAV。一眼看清本机与远端的差异，生成在客户端退出后执行的推送 / 拉取 / 还原脚本；拉取撞上本地改动时两侧都留底；配置快照、插件备份与会话备份都能还原，装坏的插件可整份回滚。支持 Windows（PowerShell）、macOS 与 Linux（Node 引擎）。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Compiles a .tex file with your own TeX Live and shows the pages inside DSH: in the right sidebar, and in a LaTeX view with an outline, a syntax-highlighted editor and an optional preview; double-clicking a page moves the editor caret to that character. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 用本机 TeX Live 编译 .tex，在右侧边栏显示页面，并提供带大纲、语法高亮编辑器与可选预览的 LaTeX 视图；双击页面可把编辑器光标移到对应字符。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Computer Use for a Wayland Linux desktop: screenshots through the XDG desktop portal, the AT-SPI accessibility tree, and pointer and keyboard events written straight to /dev/uinput, exposed to the model as mcp__linux__* tools together with clipboard, process, gsettings and notification helpers, plus a host-side doctor tool and an opt-in AI unlock switch that is off by default.
description.zh: 让 DSH 接管 Wayland Linux 桌面：经 XDG 桌面 portal 截屏、读取 AT-SPI 无障碍树、把鼠标键盘事件直接写入 /dev/uinput，并以 mcp__linux__* 工具连同剪贴板、进程、gsettings 与通知一起交给模型，附带宿主机诊断工具和默认关闭的可选解锁开关。

description.en: A middle layer for semi-automated work in DeepSeek Harness: the main session records the design interview and risks, splits the converged design into dependency-tracked draft tickets, and after manual approval in the panel dispatches each ready ticket to a separate session; child sessions return a self-assessment, and only a done report unlocks successors. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: DSH 中台：主会话记录设计盘问与风险，把收敛后的设计拆成带依赖的草稿工单，在面板中人工批准后把就绪工单派给独立子会话；子会话交回自评与汇报，只有 done 会解锁后继工单。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Adds reload and restart buttons to the DSH session header so plugin changes apply without a manual quit-and-relaunch.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话标题栏加刷新与重启按钮，改完插件不用手动退出再打开。

description.en: Lists every TCP port this machine listens on, names the process behind it, and ends that process only after re-checking it is still the same one.
description.zh: 列出本机所有 TCP 监听端口与占用它的进程，复核身份之后再结束它。

description.en: Reminds you when a DSH conversation pauses or finishes with a Windows toast, a chime and clickable on-screen cards.
description.zh: 会话暂停或结束时提醒你：Windows 通知、提示音和可点击的屏幕卡片。

description.en: Enter inserts a line break in the DSH composer, Ctrl/Cmd+Enter and Shift+Enter steer or queue the draft, and a Settings page rebinds all three keys with presets and JSON export/import of the mapping.
description.zh: Enter 在 DSH 输入框插入换行，Ctrl/Cmd+Enter 与 Shift+Enter 分别插话发送或排队发送；设置页可逐键重新指派，并提供预设与映射的 JSON 导出/导入。

description.en: Exports a DSH workspace with its code, data and conversation history as one pack, and imports it on another machine under a category you choose.
description.zh: 把 DSH 工作的代码、数据和对话记录导出成一个包，在另一台电脑上按指定分组导入。

description.en: Renders resumes in three fixed layouts (two-column engineering, wine-ribbon design, single-column ATS) to editable Word and PDF, asks follow-up questions for missing fields, and auto-shrinks the single-column layout to one page.
description.zh: 用三套固定版式（深灰蓝双栏、酒红绶带、单栏 ATS）渲染可编辑的 Word 和 PDF 简历，缺项先追问，单栏超一页自动微缩。

description.en: Plays Lottie JSON and .lottie animations in the right sidebar with packaged images, multiple animations, playback controls, and a seekable progress bar.
description.zh: 在右侧栏播放 Lottie JSON 和 .lottie 动画，支持包内图片、多动画切换、播放控制和可拖动进度条。

description.en: Local LaTeX workspace for DeepSeek Harness: CodeMirror editor, latexmk builds, structured diagnostics, PDF preview with SyncTeX, build-history audit with side-by-side diffs, local OCR for screenshots, and paper checks for citations, BibTeX and layout — 14 agent tools.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地 LaTeX 工作台：CodeMirror 编辑器、latexmk 编译、结构化诊断、带 SyncTeX 的 PDF 预览、基于构建历史的并排 audit、截图本地 OCR，以及引用/BibTeX/排版体检，共 14 个 Agent 工具。

description.en: Adds inline icon and title previews for supported pasted links in the DeepSeek Harness composer, preserving the URL for copy and send.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 聊天输入框为支持的单条链接显示行内图标和标题，复制和发送时保留网址。

description.en: Adds one button to the composer toolbar that cycles the model thinking level through every level it declares, wrapping from the highest back to the lowest.
description.zh: 在输入框工具行加一个按钮：点一下切到模型支持的下一个思考档位，走到最高档再绕回最低档，如此循环。

description.en: Mirrors every finished DSH turn into a readable local Markdown transcript: one file per session plus a latest.md pointer, atomic writes, no polling, no network. Subagent sessions are archived without stealing latest.md; hostile session ids cannot escape the target directory.
description.zh: 每轮对话结束时把该会话重写成可读的中文 Markdown：一个会话一个文件，外加指向最近一次导出的 latest.md；原子落盘、不轮询、不联网。子代理会话照常归档但不抢 latest.md；恶意会话 id 无法写出目标目录之外。

description.en: Windows-only approval popup for DeepSeek Harness: while DSH is minimized or in the tray, a pending tool approval appears as a topmost WPF window showing the session, tool and command, with allow-once, deny and open-session actions; closing the window does not answer the request. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: Windows 专用的 DSH 审批弹窗：DSH 最小化或退到托盘后，待处理的工具审批以置顶 WPF 窗口显示会话、工具与命令，可允许一次、拒绝或打开会话；关闭窗口不代表回应请求。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Uses any local image or video as the DSH surface background, with live controls for blur, media opacity, surface opacity, brightness, saturation, contrast, scale, fill mode and focal position; video also gets playback rate and pause, and every setting saves automatically. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 把任意本地图片或视频铺成 DSH 界面背景：模糊、画面不透明度、界面不透明度、亮度、饱和度、对比度、缩放、填充方式与取景位置实时可调，视频另可调速与暂停，设置自动保存。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Per-workspace Recollect memory for DeepSeek Harness. Adds a scoped memory tool and injects a memory snapshot for each agent's working directory.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按工作区隔离的 Recollect 记忆，添加作用域记忆工具，并注入与当前工作目录绑定的记忆快照。

description.en: Local-first experiment ledger: record runs with parameters, metrics, artifacts and logs; compare runs, reproduce commands, sign conclusions and export reports or bundles, with 33 bounded agent tools and an interactive panel. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 本地实验台账：记录运行的参数、指标、产物与日志，对比运行、复现命令、签名结论并导出报告或包，向 agent 提供 33 个有界工具和交互面板。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Split DeepSeek Harness's native session-wide tok/s calculation into per-model readings.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 原生按会话计算 tok/s 的方式拆分为按模型计算。

description.en: Uses an existing SSH identity to deploy a Linux collector after confirmation, shows capacity samples, daily reports and event evidence, and opens read-only DSH operations sessions.
description.zh: 使用现有 SSH 身份，经确认后部署 Linux 采集服务，在 DSH 查看容量采样、巡检日报和事件证据，并打开只读运维会话。

description.en: Linux (X11/XWayland) computer use for DSH with AT-SPI controls, screenshots, XTEST input, Unicode paste, and Chromium CDP. Includes an X11 task progress card and indicators for mouse input and click locations.
description.zh: 适用于 DSH 的 Linux（X11/XWayland）电脑操作插件，支持 AT-SPI 控件、截图、XTEST 键鼠、Unicode 粘贴和 Chromium CDP，并提供 X11 任务进度、鼠标接管和点击位置提示。

description.en: Streamlined, refactored fork of dsh-codex-connect, maintained independently alongside dsh-codex-harness: connects ChatGPT OAuth and OpenAI Codex models to DSH with strongest-first model grouping, a simplified settings UI, web search with accuracy reference, GPT-Image-2.6 generation/editing, and native compaction. Registers the same openai-codex provider, so it cannot be installed alongside upstream dsh-codex-connect.
description.zh: dsh-codex-connect 的精简重构分支，独立于上游并与 dsh-codex-harness 一起维护：通过 ChatGPT OAuth 免 API Key 接入 Codex 模型，提供按能力排序的模型列表、精简设置页、联网搜索（含准确率参考）、GPT-Image-2.6 生图/改图与原生上下文压缩。注册同一个 openai-codex provider，不能与原版 dsh-codex-connect 同装。

description.en: A precise quote and comment plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Quote almost any text, including reasoning, tool cards and search results, into a queue above the composer with an optional comment; drag to reorder, sent quotes render as cards, and ↑ jumps back to the source. Quotes are located by layered position and occurrence count, unaffected by folds or streaming.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的精确划词引用与批注插件。选中几乎任意文字，包括推理、工具卡片、搜索结果，可加批注后放入输入框上方的队列，拖拽排序；发送后渲染为卡片，按 ↑ 跳回原文。引用按分层位置与出现次数定位，不受折叠或流式文本影响。

description.en: Scheduled daily, weekly and monthly work reports for DeepSeek Harness: collect the day's traces, validate the report structure, save it, and push the next checklist onto a board.
description.zh: 定时生成日报、周报和月报：采集当天痕迹、校验结构、落盘，并把明日开场清单推进看板。

description.en: Official Dealport CLI, TypeScript SDK, MCP server & Agent Skills — 28M+ US private companies, commercial buildings, cited filings & owner contacts
description.zh: 查美国私企和商业楼宇的官方备案与业主联系方式，带引用来源，支持 CLI、SDK 和 MCP 接入。

description.en: 把「发个文章链接，我按四段式读给你」做成 DSH 插件 —— 技能（主要内容 / 亮点金句 / 关键词 / 联想）+ 微信号 iLink BOT
description.zh: 发个文章链接，就按主要内容、金句、关键词、联想四段式读给你听，还能在微信里用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: when every session in a workspace has finished, runs two closing steps in series — consolidate the diff into shared modules, then review, commit and push in batches.
description.zh: 工作区所有会话结束后，自动先整理代码再分批审查提交推送，收尾一步到位。

description.en: School channel plugin for DSH: bind a workspace/session and deliver school messages.
description.zh: 把学校消息接进 DSH 会话，平时不耗模型，有人找你才唤醒模型决定回不回。

description.en: 在 DSH 里管理 herdr 的 agent 舰队：看会话、看状态、派活、答审批、中断。
description.zh: 在 DSH 里一屏看全 herdr 的 agent 舰队，谁在干活、谁在等审批一目了然，还能直接派活、答审批、中断重启。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness bridge plugin for Infinite Canvas (v1.0+): folder-based persistent projects, right-sidebar live canvas, per-session isolated routing, and native agent tools.
description.zh: 把 Infinite Canvas 接入 DeepSeek Harness，用文件夹管理持久画布项目，侧边栏实时预览，还能让 AI 直接操作画布。

description.en: 贾维斯式球形神经元背景 for DeepSeek Harness Web：背景里的神经元球由任务真实执行数据驱动（运行状态 / 模型流式速率 / 工具调用），整层穿透点击。A Jarvis-style neural sphere driven by live agent activity.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness Web 加一层贾维斯式神经元球背景，由任务真实执行数据驱动，整层穿透点击不挡操作。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件（dsh-plugin）：中医经方问诊。228 首伤寒/金匮方，方证辨证 + 条文与 PubMed 核查，无文献支撑不开方。中医 经方 健康 失眠 疲劳 TCM classical formula consultation plugin for DSH.
description.zh: 中医经方问诊插件，先问清症状再辨证，查得到文献才开方，帮你应对失眠疲劳等小毛病。

description.en: Knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: hybrid search, graph, and an LLM-written wiki
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一套知识库，支持混合检索、知识图谱和 AI 自动写 Wiki，查资料更方便。
把 LangGraph 图注册成工具，让智能体直接跑图、管线程，节点还能调用会话里的 DSH 工具。
把只存在浏览器里的插件配置存到本地文件，换浏览器或清数据也不丢。

description.en: Math modeling contest and research paper workflow and linting tools for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 数学建模竞赛和科研论文写作的全流程工具箱，管流程、查数值、校格式、审稿翻译一站搞定。

description.en: 一个插件帮助你在侧边栏添加mc控制台
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏直接管理 Minecraft 服务器，启停重启、发指令、看实时输出，还能当智能体工具用。
装上就能用大白话聊，自动判断你想干啥，按需加载六个产品经理技能，不用记命令。

description.en: Qianwen Token Plan model provider, quota console and usage dashboard for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把千问 Token Plan 订阅接成 DSH 可用模型线路，还能只读查看套餐余量和每日用量。

description.en: 软件排行榜：苹果 App Store 与谷歌 Play 的每日榜单、飙升榜和中文简介，DSH 侧栏插件。
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏直接看苹果和谷歌应用商店的每日榜单、飙升榜和中文简介，数据留在本机。

description.en: DSH Session Assistant: pinned and recent sessions with local Codex conversation and memory import
description.zh: 在左侧栏置顶和查看最近会话，还能把本机 Codex 会话导入 DSH 继续用，并复制 Markdown 记忆。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness sidebar card: balance, today's token usage and spend (official usage endpoints first, local estimate as fallback).
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏加一张卡片，随时看 DeepSeek 余额、今日 token 用量和消费，官方接口优先、本地估算兜底。

description.en: A-share industry heatmap, watchlist and portfolio for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里看 A 股行业云图、盯自选股、管持仓，一站搞定。
在对话里自动给出下一步建议卡片，帮你顺着思路继续提问或操作。

description.en: Character-card writing and roleplay for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在 DSH 里跟角色卡聊天、玩角色扮演，支持单聊和 2–5 人群聊，还能流式输出。

description.en: 万法 AI 的 DSH 插件：余额/用量/分时价/API Key/一键测试
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏直接看万法 AI 余额、用量和分时价，管 API Key，还能一键测连通。

description.en: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里打开微信读书书架、分屏阅读和按需找书。
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里扫码登录微信读书，同步书架并分屏阅读，还能按需找书。

description.en: 小鱼创作台 —— DSH 网文创作辅助插件。AI 主编带六帮手写长篇：七阶段工作流、逐章去 AI 味门禁、伏笔状态机、可视化创作台（15 tab / 全书体检 / 六维趋势 / 章节蓝图 / 合规体检 / 题材雷达）。书稿是 novel/ 纯文本文件，grep 即得。
description.zh: AI 主编带六个帮手写长篇网文，七阶段流程加去 AI 味门禁，书稿纯文本可 grep。

description.en: Zi Wei Dou Shu charting for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在 DSH 里本地排紫微斗数命盘，排完直接把整张盘交给 AI 解读，不用再复制到别处。

description.en: 把华为云码道（CodeArts Agent）接入 dsh-go：本机 OpenAI 兼容桥 + 原生状态条与面板
description.zh: 把华为云码道模型接进 dsh-go，保存凭证后就能在模型选择器里直接用。

description.en: AI-Veil takeover indicator: registers the veil_emit and veil_cancel tools so every agent takeover action shows a system-level banner and border, plays a cue, sends a desktop notification, and offers one-key abort.
description.zh: AI-Veil 接管提示器：把 Agent 的接管动作注册为 veil_emit / veil_cancel 两个工具，桌面端随之弹出系统级横幅与边框、播放提示音、发桌面通知，并可一键中止。

description.en: macOS 通用 AI Agent 置顶悬浮回答卡片：支持 Antigravity、DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 与 Zed，不切窗完成审批、作答与追问，支持完整键盘控制并动态自适应主题配色。
description.zh: macOS 上置顶悬浮的回答卡片，不用切窗就能审批、作答和追问，全键盘操作，主题自动适配。

description.en: 藏海 canghai · 二次元知识图鉴引擎 + 控制面板（QQAgent / DSH 双宿主，可插拔外部数据源，本地秒查）
description.zh: 把动漫游戏名场面和角色设定收进本地，聊天机器人不联网也能秒查「这是什么、他是谁」。

description.en: Tianyi Cloud (cloud.189.cn) MCP server + DSH plugin: list, search, download links, upload, mkdir, delete, recycle bin, quota. Zero runtime deps.
description.zh: 把天翼云盘接进 AI 助手，列目录、搜文件、传下载、管回收站和配额都能直接对话搞定。

description.en: dsh plugin: which tools your agents use, which fail, and what each costs in every request
description.zh: 看清每个请求里智能体用了哪些工具、哪些失败、各自花多少成本。

description.en: Long-term memory plugin with auto-recall, per-repo isolation, a memory graph, user-profile injection, an Ebbinghaus forgetting curve, and OpenVINO embeddings.
description.zh: 长期记忆插件：自动召回、按仓库隔离、记忆图谱、用户画像注入、艾宾浩斯遗忘曲线与 OpenVINO 向量化。

description.en: DS节约插件 — context/token saver for DeepSeek on OpenCode and DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
description.zh: 用便宜模型筛掉大段工具输出，预测换窗时机并平滑交接，帮 DeepSeek 长会话省 token 不降质。
在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接浏览乐享个人和团队知识库，打开原文并搜索，不用来回切换。

description.en: Replaces the sidebar account avatar with your own picture: upload, crop, and it is stored on this machine. The account menu, sign-in and notifications stay untouched.
description.zh: 把侧边栏账号头像换成自己上传的图片，还能自定义昵称，图片只存在本机。

description.en: Sidebar notebook for DeepSeek Harness: records what the assistant did, reads checked notes before every task.
description.zh: 侧边栏小本子，自动记下助手干过的事，每次任务前先翻看笔记，帮你记住关键决定和偏好。

description.en: UI/UX 设计师 dsh 角色包：人设 + 8 只读 Skill + uiux preset
description.zh: 装上这个包，你的 dsh 就变成 UI/UX 设计师，自带人设和 8 个只读设计技能，随时帮你搞定界面和体验。

description.en: DSH 会话标题栏展示 Today for AI 的 AI 动态
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话标题栏轮播 Today for AI 的 AI 热点和快讯，点开就能看详情。

description.en: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地表格插件：左侧入口、表格网页、15 个表格/导入工具与 AI表格模式预设。MIT
description.zh: 在 DSH 左侧打开本地表格应用，新建、编辑、导入表格，还能让 AI 直接读写和操作表格。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for alibaba/open-code-review, reusing the official OCR CLI and skills under Apache-2.0.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接调用阿里官方代码审查能力，帮你快速审代码、查问题。

description.en: Altare 云平台官方 API 接入 DeepSeek Harness：13 个工具覆盖应用/电源/部署/日志/文件/变量/备份/快照/域名端口/Job/Schedule/团队审计，按 token scope 自动鉴权
description.zh: 把 Altare 云平台官方 API 接进 DSH，AI 凭团队 Token 就能管应用、部署、日志、备份和域名端口。

description.en: 让 DSH agent 自己启动 Android 模拟器、安装 APK（含 ABI 预检与 ARM64 转译判断）、点击 / 滑动 / 输入、看截图与 UI 树和 logcat —— 「改代码 → 装包 → 操作 → 断言」的闭环；多会话默认各用一台独立模拟器，工具按需加载。
description.zh: 让 agent 自己开模拟器装 APK、点滑输入看截图日志，跑通改代码到验证的闭环。

description.en: 在 DeepSeek Harness 对话里划词做分类注释：原文保留同色色块、点注释跳回原文、一键汇总插入输入框。 / Select text in a DSH reply to file color-coded annotations, jump back to a passage, and insert the digest into the composer.
description.zh: 在对话里划词做分类注释，色块保留原文，点注释跳回出处，还能一键汇总插入输入框。
在每条回答下方显示本次花费和累计花费，让你随时掌握用量开销。

description.en: 会话管理 · DSH 设置页插件：搜索已归档会话、查看占用体积，多选恢复或永久删除（含残留清理与延迟删除重试）
description.zh: 在设置页里搜索已归档的会话，查看占用空间，还能多选恢复或彻底删除。

description.en: Session-scoped auto-approval and approval history for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 给每条对话单独开关自动审批，分三档策略，还能查审批记录，省得反复点确认。

description.en: One DSH provider over a fallback chain of every registered route, with reasoning effort inherited from the caller.
description.zh: 把所有已注册路由串成一条备用链，统一成一个 DSH 提供方，调用方的推理强度自动继承。

description.en: DSH Web 头像插件：AI/用户头像、导入即裁切、按会话与子智能体自定义头像与名字，附主 AI 与子智能体的群聊时间线。
description.zh: 给 DSH 网页加头像：AI 和你的消息各显头像，按会话自定义头像和名字，还有群聊时间线。

description.en: Floating in-app keyboard battlefield HUD for DSH: every keypress becomes gunfire, graded by how long you hold the key
description.zh: 把每次敲键盘变成炮火声，悬浮窗实时显示手速、按键时长和键位热力图，打字也能玩出战场感。

description.en: 小白模式：给 DeepSeek Harness 的可选 agent 预设。说人话、一次一步、不清楚就问、没把握就联网查。不改工具、不改权限。 | An optional plain-language agent preset for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加个「小白模式」预设，说人话、一次一步、不懂就问，新手也能轻松上手。
根据最近两条人类消息自动生成会话标题，让会话列表一眼看清聊了什么。
把 DSH 侧栏顶部入口收成一行统一图标，让侧栏只留工作区内容，界面更清爽。

description.en: Enhance the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) sidebar workspace context menu with Copy workspace path, Copy more, 1-click favorite app open, Open in external apps, Open Git repository, Move to top, New session, Open latest session, and Archive idle sessions.
description.zh: 给 DSH 侧边栏工作区右键菜单加料：复制路径、一键收藏打开、外部应用打开、置顶等，操作更顺手。

description.en: A bookshelf plugin for DeepSeek Harness — read & manage TXT/EPUB/PDF/AZW3 libraries inside the app.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接读书、管书，侧边栏书架支持 TXT、EPUB、PDF、AZW3 等多种格式。

description.en: Parallel branch studio for DeepSeek Harness: fork isolated branches, run each with its own model/prompt, compare results, and promote the winner back with verification and rollback.
description.zh: 把任务拆成多个独立分支并行跑，各用不同模型和提示词，比完再把最优结果验证后合回主线。

description.en: Local photo capture plugin for DeepSeek Harness (macOS): live preview above the input box; captured photos go straight into the message as attachments. Comes with a bundled macOS camera app.
description.zh: 在输入框上方实时预览并拍照，照片自动作为附件进消息，macOS 免装相机软件。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin — a right-sidebar tab that maps skills, tools and MCP tools used in the current session, with per-capability call counts.
description.zh: 在右侧边栏实时查看当前会话用到的技能、工具和 MCP 工具，并统计每个能力的调用次数。

description.en: 我老感觉模型在孤立我所以劳烦它改成同一边了
description.zh: 把用户消息也挪到左边，和助手回复同侧排版，聊天不再像隔空喊话。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness sidebar plugin: Work/Chat switch plus DeepSeek web chat history inside Harness
description.zh: 在 Harness 侧栏一键切换工作/对话模式，把网页版 DeepSeek 历史对话接进来，点开就能接着聊。

description.en: DSH Chrome 插件 + MV3 扩展：让 DeepSeek Harness 接管本机 Chrome，读写页面、提交表单、抓接口、多标签对照，61 个动作
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 直接接管本机 Chrome，读页面、填表、抓接口、多标签对照，61 个动作全带回执。
